description: Detection rules for the CodeAlpha NIDS (Task 4). Each rule has an id, name, severity, description and detection parameters (threshold + time window in seconds).

rules.description: One source IP probed many distinct destination ports on a single host in a short time window — typical reconnaissance before an attack.
rules.name: Port Scan Detected

rules.description: A source sent a high rate of TCP SYN packets with very few ACKs — half-open connections pile up and exhaust the target (SYN flood DoS).
rules.name: SYN Flood (DoS) Detected

rules.description: Many connection attempts to SSH (port 22) from one source in a short time — a password guessing / brute-force attack.
rules.name: SSH Brute Force Detected

rules.description: Many HTTP requests (including repeated POST /login attempts) to a web server from one source in a short time — credential stuffing or login brute force.
rules.name: HTTP Brute Force / Credential Stuffing

rules.description: A packet payload contains a known SQL injection pattern (for example ' OR '1'='1, UNION SELECT, DROP TABLE) — an attempt to steal or damage database data.
rules.name: SQL Injection Attempt

rules.description: A source sent a high rate of ICMP echo requests, or probed many different hosts with ping — a flood DoS or a ping sweep to map the network.
rules.name: ICMP Flood / Ping Sweep
